fountain.line: Two blocks from the subway, three from the fountain
stanza: Out from my window across from the city

Where I walk to break in new shoes

I ask where she's headed, she tells me, "Ohio:
I've not seen my mother in ages"

stanza: Where there were deserts I saw fountains

stanza: It's a Hollywood summer

stanza: Weren't we the stars in Heaven?
Weren't we the salt in the sea?
Dragon in the new warm mountain

You held me the whole way through
But I couldn't say the words like you
I was scared, Indigo, but I wanted to
I was scared, Indigo, but I wanted to

mountain.line: I've stumbled on the side of twelve misty mountains
stanza: Oh, where have you been, my blue-eyed son?
And where have you been, my darling young one?
I've stumbled on the side of twelve misty mountains
I've walked and I crawled on six crooked highways
I've stepped in the middle of seven sad forests

I've been ten thousand miles in the mouth of a graveyard

mountain.line: Farewell Purplе Mountains
stanza: Farewell Purplе Mountains
I see a range of cumulus

mountain.line: You give me miles and miles of mountains
stanza: What I am to you is not real
What I am to you, you do not need
What I am to you is not what you mean to me

stanza: These mist covered mountains

But my home is the lowlands

To be brothers in arms

stanza: I had a little boat
I called it Life
I went out and never came back

stanza: On Calvary Mountain

stanza: Daddy's gone; my brother's out huntin' in the mountains
Big John's been drinkin' since the river took Emmy Lou

stanza: If I had a mountain

stanza: There's a man who's climbed a mountain

He can think her there beside him

stanza: The door it opened slowly

stanza: I must stand by the side of the mountain
